text: Sabse mushkil case...\nsirf tez dimaag\nsolve karega!
Clue isi video mein hai.\nDhyaan se dekhna!
Purani vaseeyat:\nsab kuch bade\nbete AJAY ka
Pichhle hafte\nnayi vaseeyat: sab\nbhateeje AMIT ka
Raat Dadaji MARE MILE...\nalmari khuli thi!
Ramu raat mein thaila\nlekar kamre ke paas\nghoom raha tha
BETA AJAY\n"Nayi vaseeyat ka to\npata hi nahi tha"
BHATEEJA AMIT\n"Main raat bhar\npadh raha tha"
NAUKAR RAMU\n"Thaile mein kapde the,\nmain gaon ja raha tha!"
VAKIL SAHAB\n"Nayi vaseeyat maine\nhi likhi thi"
Shivam ki nazar se\nkoi nahi bachta.
